_comment: OCR transcriptions for pages of the filed record that carry no text layer. Committed deliberately: OCR introduces transcription error into a litigation answer surface, so it runs as a reviewed pass rather than during a build, and ordinary builds and CI consume this cache instead of re-running OCR. That also makes the corpus reproducible: an engine version bump cannot silently rewrite the record. Entries are keyed by document slug and page and carry the sha256 of the source PDF, so refiling a document invalidates its OCR. `usable: false` means OCR was attempted and the result was not trusted; that page keeps its no-text stub. OCR text is NEVER quotable: verify-citations refuses a quoted citation to an OCR page.
